proposals.mechanism: Concrete registered Interaction world entity records actual player action UUID plus level gameTime separately for last attack and last server interaction. Attacking player reaches skipAttackInteraction through Player.attack after Forge hook; no economic payment alleged. Whole own disk pair encodes/decodes two typed PlayerAction records, alongside dimensions/response; generic Entity disk bridge actually invokes pair. After load getLastAttacker/getTarget resolves saved UUID to currently present player in entity level. Registered execute on attacker/target forks current command source to resolved live entity while filtering removed entities. Persistence thus retains action receipt used as later authoritative recipient/source relation; it does not replay original attack advancement on load. Both action channels and all command/helper/base methods one owner at most1.
proposals.dedup: FTB960 persists authored interaction objective kind/filter, not runtime last interactor receipt or its command context; do not confuse observation definition with actual action history. Native27b persists reputational gossip values per subject and UUID conversion; this owner instead holds latest single actual player+timestamp action record with executable postload relation. Champions28be owns affix rank and damage-type adaptation counters with known broken private-data read, not durable acting-player receipt. No prior accepted row has direct Interaction.java evidence in963 snapshot; negative search is only support, not sufficient by itself. Novel boundary recommended1 is concrete world action record -> live player identity rebinding -> command-source consumer, not two UUID fields/width/height/codec helpers. No economic resource, accumulated per-player history, quest completion or idempotent reward receipt implied.
limits: Each channel retains only last action; subsequent different player overwrites it. timestamp is raw level gameTime, no expiry or age comparison here, no history list or acknowledgement that command consumed it. No automatic once-only processing; repeated commands can act again on same receipt.

Missing action key explicitly clears that channel. Present malformed CODEC data only assigns inside resultOrPartial.ifPresent: unsuccessful decode can retain old receipt on reused entity; fresh constructor remains null. Codec may expose partial result. Writer result().ifPresent silently omits encode failure, unlike logged reader; exact DFU internals not expanded.

UUID lookup is entity current level.getPlayerByUUID; player offline/in another dimension/unavailable returns null and command fork yields no target. Saved UUID receipt remains; no deferred queue, cross-dimension global resolution or ownership transfer.

Attack method itself lacks explicit server-side guard and can update local attack receipt and client timestamp; only ServerPlayer triggers criterion. Server interact branch explicitly records. Do not claim all copies authoritative; actual saved server entity is required. No original advancement is re-triggered from disk read.

Response gates return/hit feedback after attack record creation, not whether receipt exists. Width/height typed numeric guard preserves constructor or reused values if absent; response missingfalse. Negative/NaN dimensions and arbitrary timestamp not validated by own local methods. Bounding box re-derived after load.

Execute relation changes source entity via withEntity, not necessarily source world/position/permission level. Subsequent command effects, network interaction dispatch, getPlayerByUUID implementation and all general entity serialization internals were not fully read. Inspected actual registered relation closure and normal own hooks only.

Temporary world interaction receipt is not a Dynasty permanent player Clone field, paid asset ledger or completed task. No production change, native runtime claim, original game started, upstream execution, network, commit or push.
